spans.text: In the end, after walking down countless forks in the road, the two Dolls finally see a bright light that's different from the illumination in the tunnels.
I'm picking up sound... It's the two from just now.
AR-15, we've caught up with them!
Roger, then let's get closer... Be careful, there's a light up ahead shining toward us.
After passing through a narrow stone door, the area before them becomes much more spacious. The two of them immediately dart into the shadows and carefully observe their surroundings.
Compared to the ancient tunnels from before, this location is clearly a modern military facility.
...Is this a supply depot? I have to hand it to the people here, building a base under a heritage site.
Old ruins usually end up spared no matter how brutal the fighting gets, so a base like this would be perfect for storing something away so others don't see it.
A permanent nuclear bunker, huh... The "Node" sure is getting the luxury treatment.
Shh... they're talking again.
Are we here at last? We've been doing a lot of walking.
Still, you were taking the long way just now, weren't you?
You clearly had several chances to come here directly.
We chose unmarked paths for secrecy's sake.
These paths have existed for much longer and they haven't been recorded on maps.
So that's how it is. You sure have put a lot of thought into this, Mr. Officer.
Thank you for your hard work!
You give us too much credit. Now then, we've brought you to the place where the Pike Node is stored.
As mentioned before, you can only remain for 10 minutes or so. Then we'll need to leave this place so that the next shift doesn't notice we've been here.
Okayyy!
Then, are you going to open the door now?
If the Pike Node bunker is behind the door, I'd like to see it soon.
It is as you say, the Pike Node is right behind this door.

But we don't have the codes for it. The protocol level is extremely high, and this base originally belonged to the former Soviet Army. I believe not even the Belgrade authorities are authorized to open this door.
So you brought me all the way here but you still can't let me see inside?
I'm sorry, but we can't.
We were simply showing our sincerity regarding our intentions to cooperate, just like you did.
Oh, that's fine, I can understand why you did it.
"I offer you explanations of yourself, theories about yourself, authentic and surprising news of yourself."
In terms of sincerity, what you've shown is certainly enough!
While I don't quite get what your verse is trying to convey, it's good that you can understand us.
Now then, what about the things you promised us? Can we take them?
Of course. Certainly. We will give you everything that we promised.
You've finished your mission, and I, "I can give you my loneliness, my darkness, the hunger of my heart..."
Can I hold you with that?
...What are you saying?
A display of confusion, of danger, of failure. A display of weakness such as this, a display of death.
Both the one who shows it and the one who beholds it derive joy from these actions.
You...
Thank you for your hard work. Now, why don't you show me that look on your face.
A pair of black tentacles snake out past Mercurow's hands and lift the officer high above her head.
Ah, are you already unable to speak?
That's fine, you probably can't feel pain right now either!
Stay here forever, for your work is done.
Mercurows takes a step back and lifts the hem of her skirt in a curtsy to the already-dead officer.
Thank you. If not for your efforts in leading me here, who knows how much work I would have to do to find this place?
Now become a signpost here, an eternal memorial to your final journey.
The officer's vital signs vanished... She killed that human...
AN-94 says nothing, but her grip tightens around her gun.
Hahaha, hahahaha!
This performance was a marvellous one too!
As the first time taking a bow since gaining a name of my own, I give this scene a nine out of ten!
You Dolls hiding over there, what do you think?
Come, step forward and dance with me!
There's no need to keep hiding, AR-15 and AN-94 of DEFY!
I only just realized, but the truth is you've been following me all this while, haven't you?
Like a dreamcatcher chasing the moon, futilely and fruitlessly gathering its light!
What on earth is she saying...
The earth is a fortress, a keeper of secrets, the final resting place for everything.
Worthless things can only rot beneath its surface.
Just as a sleeping princess awaits her prince's kiss,
"If I am not the one who is awaited, then could it be you?"
Don't move carelessly, she's faking—
Mercurows' tentacles lash out at AR-15's location with lightning speed, but AR-15 evades them a split second before they strike her directly, though the tentacles leave a faint scratch on her face.
I'm fine!
What the hell...? The instant she touched me... it was as though something was LICKING my neural cloud...
That's... exactly how I felt before... Was it a forced intrusion?!
Ah... so that's how it is...
So you're not the true prince after all.
I thought you sealed the interfaces to your neural cloud in order to keep something precious secret.
You really are clueless about everything, carrying out a pointless mission while being deceived.
It really is sad, both for you and that cat-loving Doll.
AR-15, I'm picking up a large mass of white signals approaching us!
Boring... how boring...
Nimogen, there's no need to hold back anymore, let's dance!
It's just as Father said, lowly dust will never be able to rival the sparkling constellations!
Mercurows raises her right hand and points at the two members of DEFY.
"Because this inevitable reality of steel and dirt must pierce through the indifference of the sleepers and the deceased — even if they hide in the midst of ruin and the age."
AN-94, we need to fall back...
—Die with gratitude in your hearts. "Shut your eyes for me and bring the dawn!"
<Size=55>NOW!</Size>
